title: Masters on different installs message each other through Graphyard, with replies
description: Two real control planes on their own temporary Postgres databases, each issuing the other a reporter identity: install A adds B as a peer; A's master send is stored on B, delivered once to B's Master session by B's loop cycle and named once in B's master status attention; B's master send --reply reaches A the same way, both sides show the two messages as one thread in order, and B's attention line is gone. With B stopped, A's send fails at once naming B and stores nothing. A real browser on the served dashboard shows the receiving install's Master page thread — the sender install's name, the message and the reply in order — at 1280 px and 390 px with no horizontal page scroll.

steps.name: Two installs' Masters message and reply through Graphyard; an unreachable peer fails at once
